topic.title: A $1,500 Black Friday haul on a credit card, paid at the minimum due

title: Black Friday on a card: the minimum due trap 🛍️
description:
What does a $1,500 Black Friday haul really cost if you only pay the minimum?
An assumed card rate and minimum due, computed month by month: how long it takes and the interest you pay. No card or bank named. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
cta: Did you fall for the minimum? Comment

lines.text: My Black Friday haul cost $1,500. Paid at the minimum, it costs $3,019.
The bill says only $45 due this month. Easy!
That's the trap. The card charges about 22.8% a year on everything you leave.
Next Black Friday, he has paid $507. He still owes $1,304.
At the minimum, it takes about 9 years. That's $1,519 in interest, for stuff you forgot.
Pay the full bill, and a deal stays a deal. If not, this Black Friday haul...
